git_history_audit.plain_teacher_initialization_bug_candida: The launcher passes --pretrained_bn, but squeeze.py hard-codes pretrained_weights=False when calling load_model. For torchvision ResNet18 this makes pretrained_bn inert and leaves the whole backbone randomly initialized. The later CAL trainer adds and uses an explicit --pretrained_weights flag.
git_history_audit.coverage: Only a CUB plain-teacher launcher existed. No commit contains the referenced plain recover/recover.py or plain baseline relabel/validation launchers.

readme_behavior.teacher: The squeeze scripts train and save pretrained models locally; no checkpoint download is linked.

baseline_pipeline_coverage.checkpoint_contract_gap: HEAD only has CAL-suffixed squeeze launchers, but Git history resolves the plain ResNet18.pth teacher contract: the plain trainer/launcher were added in e07285b and deleted in 908d10f. Recovery/relabel/validation remain unresolved.
baseline_pipeline_coverage.finding: The released repository does not contain an executable end-to-end plain SRe2L++ baseline pipeline for any of the three fine-grained datasets.
